summary.business_type: Commercial & Product Photography Studio (Local Service — Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India)
top_findings: CRITICAL: Cloudflare robots.txt overrides block GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended — AI search visibility is zero
HIGH: 4 blog posts missing from sitemap.xml — orphaned from index discovery
HIGH: BlogPosting schema missing datePublished/dateModified — no article rich results
HIGH: Gallery page is client-only — no server-rendered SEO metadata for 32 images
MEDIUM: Contact page has thin meta description (5 words)
quick_wins: Disable Cloudflare AI bot blocking rule (5 min)
Add 4 missing blog posts to sitemap.ts (15 min)
Add datePublished to BlogPosting schema (30 min)
Write specific Contact page meta description (5 min)
Add BreadcrumbList to service sub-pages (30 min)

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Server-side rendered Next.js on Cloudflare with OpenNext
Comprehensive security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, etc.)
Canonical URLs via absoluteUrl() helper
Excellent llms.txt with full navigation and content
robots.ts correctly allows AI crawlers

findings.title: robots.txt Cloudflare Override Blocks AI Crawlers
findings.description: Cloudflare-managed rules append Disallow for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Bytespider, CCBot, Applebot-Extended, meta-externalagent — overriding the site's own Allow: /. AI search visibility is effectively zero.
findings.recommendation: Disable Cloudflare's AI Scrapers and Crawlers blocking rule in Security → Bots → Configure Bot Management.

findings.title: 4 Blog Posts Missing from Sitemap
findings.description: sitemap.xml has 13 blog posts but codebase has 17 URLs. Missing: product-photography-small-business-india, product-photography-lighting-setup, how-to-photograph-products-ecommerce, food-photography-restaurants.
findings.recommendation: Add 4 missing URLs to blogPostsSEO array in src/app/sitemap.ts.

findings.title: No Custom 404 Page
findings.description: No src/app/not-found.tsx file. Default Next.js 404 provides no helpful navigation or SEO signal.
findings.recommendation: Create custom 404 page with metadata, links to key pages, and helpful message.

findings.title: CSP Header Contains Stale Vercel Reference
findings.description: Content-Security-Policy includes https://vercel.live but site runs on Cloudflare Workers. Minor hygiene issue.
findings.recommendation: Remove https://vercel.live from CSP script-src directive.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: 12+ long-form technical blog articles (300-800 words each)
Comprehensive service pages (200-360 lines each)
737-line Dehradun landing page with locally-targeted content
Strong E-E-A-T signals on About page
Legal pages (Terms/Privacy) present and linked

findings.title: BlogPosting Schema Missing Date Fields
findings.description: generateBlogPostingSchema() in schemas.ts does not include datePublished or dateModified. Google requires these for article rich results.
findings.recommendation: Add datePublished and dateModified to schema generator and pass dates from blog post data.

findings.title: Gallery Page Client-Only — Limited Metadata
findings.description: gallery/page.tsx is 'use client' — cannot export metadata. All 32 images load via client JS. Layout metadata is generic.
findings.recommendation: Convert to SSR+client hybrid. Enhance layout metadata with location keywords and specific image descriptions.

findings.title: Contact Page Thin Meta Description
findings.description: Meta description is only 'Have a project in mind?' — 5 words, no keywords, no location context.
findings.recommendation: Write 120-160 char description with keywords: product photography, Dehradun, quote, commercial.

findings.title: Terms/Privacy Pages — No Schema, No Internal Links
findings.description: Both pages lack WebPage schema and have no internal links to service or blog pages.
findings.recommendation: Add WebPage schema, expand descriptions, add related links section.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Consistent title pattern: '%s — Rahul Chanda Photography'
Descriptive H1 tags on all pages
Natural keyword targeting ('Product Photography Dehradun')
Internal linking between blog and services

findings.title: Missing Breadcrumb Schema on Service Sub-Pages
findings.description: 4 service sub-pages have Service schema but no BreadcrumbList. generateBreadcrumbSchema exists but is not applied.
findings.recommendation: Import and render generateBreadcrumbSchema on all service sub-pages.

findings.title: No OpenGraph Article Tags on Blog Posts
findings.description: Blog posts don't include og:type='article' with article:published_time, article:author, article:section tags.
findings.recommendation: Add openGraph.type='article' with temporal metadata to blog post pages.

findings.title: Inconsistent Image Alt Text
findings.description: Portfolio images have varying alt text quality — some specific, some generic. Not all images have descriptive alt text.
findings.recommendation: Audit all img tags and ensure alt text is descriptive and keyword-relevant.

categories.name: Schema & Structured Data
what_works: JSON-LD on most pages (LocalBusiness, ProfessionalService, Service, Person, BlogPosting, QAPage)
Correctly uses QAPage (not deprecated FAQPage)
AggregateRating + Review on homepage
BreadcrumbList on homepage and blog

findings.title: BlogPosting Missing Date and Publisher
findings.description: Schema lacks datePublished, dateModified, and publisher fields. Cannot appear in Google article rich results.
findings.recommendation: Add datePublished, dateModified, and publisher to generateBlogPostingSchema.

findings.title: No WebSite + SearchAction Schema
findings.description: Missing sitelinks searchbox potential. WebSite schema exists but lacks potentialAction.SearchAction.
findings.recommendation: Add SearchAction with target URL template for blog search.

findings.title: No VideoObject Schema for Hero Video
findings.description: Homepage hero video has no VideoObject schema. Cannot appear in Google Video search results.
findings.recommendation: Add VideoObject schema with thumbnailUrl, contentUrl, duration.

findings.title: No ImageObject Schema on Portfolio Images
findings.description: Gallery and portfolio images lack individual ImageObject schema with caption, license, and creditText.
findings.recommendation: Add ImageObject schema for high-value portfolio images.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: Dynamic imports with { ssr: false } for all major sections
Font optimization via next/font with display: swap
Video lazy loading with IntersectionObserver
Aggressive CDN caching (s-maxage=31536000)

findings.title: Hero Video Missing Poster Image
findings.description: poster={undefined} in Hero.tsx — no placeholder while video loads. Causes blank frame and potential CLS.
findings.recommendation: Generate 1200x675 WebP poster from video first frame and add poster attribute.

findings.title: No Modern Image Formats (WebP/AVIF)
findings.description: Portfolio images use standard JPEG format. No picture elements or Next.js Image with format negotiation.
findings.recommendation: Use Next.js Image component with formats=['image/avif', 'image/webp'] for automatic format negotiation.

findings.title: Gallery Client-Side Rendering Impact
findings.description: All 32 gallery images load via client JavaScript. No server-rendered img tags in initial HTML.
findings.recommendation: Convert to SSR+client hybrid. Server-render first 6 images, client-load rest.

findings.title: Inconsistent Lazy Loading
findings.description: Gallery and portfolio images lack consistent loading='lazy' attribute. Below-fold images may load eagerly.
findings.recommendation: Add loading='lazy' to all below-fold images, priority to above-fold images.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Comprehensive llms.txt with navigation, articles, and studio details
Content negotiation support (Accept: text/markdown)
robots.ts correctly allows all major AI crawlers
Rich structured data across all pages

findings.title: Cloudflare Blocks All Major AI Crawlers
findings.description: Cloudflare-managed Disallow rules block GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Bytespider, CCBot, Applebot-Extended, meta-externalagent. Only PerplexityBot is unblocked.
findings.recommendation: Disable Cloudflare AI Scrapers blocking rule immediately. 5-minute fix.

findings.title: No llms-full.txt
findings.description: Site has llms.txt but no llms-full.txt (extended version with full page content for deeper AI ingestion).
findings.recommendation: Generate public/llms-full.txt with expanded content from all pages.

findings.title: Content Negotiation Unverified
findings.description: llms.txt claims Accept: text/markdown support across routes, but this was not verified during audit.
findings.recommendation: Test with curl -H 'Accept: text/markdown' and verify markdown response. If not working, implement or remove claim.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Disable Cloudflare AI bot blocking rule (Cloudflare Dashboard → Security → Bots)
Add 4 missing blog posts to sitemap.ts blogPostsSEO array
Add datePublished + dateModified to BlogPosting schema in schemas.ts
Write specific Contact page meta description (120-160 chars)

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add BreadcrumbList schema to 4 service sub-pages
Add poster attribute to hero video (generate WebP from video frame)
Add og:type='article' with temporal metadata to blog posts
Convert gallery to SSR+client hybrid for server-rendered images
Add VideoObject schema to homepage for hero video
Create custom 404 page with metadata and helpful navigation

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Add WebSite + SearchAction schema for sitelinks searchbox
Audit and improve all image alt text across portfolio
Add WebPage schema to Terms and Privacy pages
Generate llms-full.txt with expanded page content
Add ImageObject schema to high-value portfolio images
Expand Terms/Privacy content with internal links to services

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Monitor Google Search Console for crawl errors and indexation
Track AI search citations (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude) monthly
Re-audit after deploying each phase of fixes
Update blog content freshness (add dates, refresh outdated info)
Test content negotiation (Accept: text/markdown) after deployment
